name: Sale Preparation
description: Define the outcome, readiness baseline, buyer profile, and controlled process.

name: Valuation and Value Building
description: Understand value drivers and improve durable transferability.

name: Financial Readiness
description: Organize consistent financial evidence for authorized review.

description: Plan management, family, and partner ownership changes.

description: Sequence communication, closing, continuity, and post-close work.
